about: Documents looked at closely before the second tier was drawn (2026-09-26): their control drawings, cites or sheets were examined, so none may become held-out 2 (assembliesSplit.mjs drawTier2). Sources: the unseen audit record (a set with an applied, hand-checked decision), the bug catalogues (a set cited for its content), and sheets rendered and viewed outside the title-block sweep. Every eligible document's title block was also viewed at low resolution for drafters.json; that applies to all candidates alike and is disclosed there.
